Hi, I'm Ruchi Sarraf — Junior Software Developer

Building responsive web applications using modern technologies and AI-assisted development tools.

Motivated and detail-oriented developer with hands-on experience in building and deploying web applications. Skilled in frontend development, backend API integration, and debugging, with a strong willingness to learn and adapt to modern technologies.

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I am a Junior Software Developer passionate about creating responsive and user-friendly web applications.

During my internship at OctaTribe, I gained hands-on experience in developing and deploying web applications, integrating APIs, and improving frontend performance. I also used AI-assisted tools to enhance development speed and efficiency while learning the underlying concepts.
I believe in writing clean, maintainable code and solving problems effectively to build impactful digital solutions.

My strengths include being a quick learner who easily adapts to new technologies, having a strong problem-solving mindset, and maintaining a detail-oriented and organized approach to work. I am also proficient in using AI-assisted development tools to enhance productivity and efficiency.
